levels.surface: أبي عمران موسى بن زنجويه الأرمنيّ

notes: Two routes: the compiler's chain to Abdullah b. al-Hakam, then a second line («رويته عن أبي؛ و محمّد بن الحسن ... ») read as a second group; the father's own route is not written further, so the second group is a best reading
«و اسمه سفيان» after «الجريريّ» is an identifying gloss and is left out
«أبيه» in the first line is the father of Husayn b. Ahmad: relation link; the compiler's own father is «أبي» (second occurrence)
Blessings («- رضي اللّه عنه -») are left out
